name: Glyphic Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Glyphic Tablet and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You be among da most powerful beings on da planet, adventurer... there no arguin' dat. And everyone know it... know it good, too!

But ya must be weary! 'cause it not orc, or elf, or dwarf dat you should be scared of... it be da tings you can'na see. Magic be powerful. Make you do tings you may not want to do. Make ya tink you more powerful then you really be. Be patient. Be smart.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Ya look to please Mai'ah already, adventurer. Dat be good. You give Mai'ah respect, and Mai'ah maybe give you respect back. But enough o' dat, you be here to learn 'bout magic, not hear Mai'ah talk.

There be only one ting Mai'ah can no teach you 'bout magic, adventurer, and dat's how to stop da corruptin'.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Glyphic Tablet
quests.objectiveText: Read the Glyphic Tablet and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
